[[Lustenau]] | capacity = 2,000 | chrtitle = President | chairman = Dr. Omer Rehman | manager = [[Philipp Hagspiel]] | league = [[Austrian Regionalliga West]] | season = [[2025–26 Austrian Regionalliga#Regionalliga West|2025–26]] | position = Austrian Regionalliga West, 12th of 17 | pattern_la1 = _whiteborder | pattern_b1 = _bluehorizontal | pattern_ra1 = _whiteborder | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 0000FF | body1 = 0000FF | rightarm1 = 0000FF | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = 0000FF | pattern_la2 = _whiteborder | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = _whiteborder | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FF4500 | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = 191970 | socks2 = FF4500 }} '''FC Lustenau 07''' is a [[association football|football]] club based in [[Lustenau]], Vorarlberg. They currently compete in the [[Austrian Regionalliga]], the third tier of [[Football in Austria#League system|Austrian football]]. Until the [[2012–13 Austrian Football First League|2012–13]] they played in the [[2. Liga (Austria)|Second League]]. Although the club has never had much domestic success, it played a pivotal role in the development of European club football prior to UEFA-sanctioned competitions.
